jobs.title: Gaming Category & Marketing Manager — Switzerland
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location : Zurich
Working Model : 5 days/a week in the office (on-site)

The Team and Role:
The Gaming Category & Marketing Manager — Switzerland will lead our marketing execution across multiple channels both online and offline and deliver a best-in-class customer experience for our end users.
This position will work closely with different functions within the Regional Team, Cluster Category Manager, eCommerce Marketing Manager, Account Manager, and other supporting roles to drive the strategy into action.
This isn't just about spreadsheets; it’s about the esports ecosystem . We’re looking for a marketing specialist who truly lives the gaming lifestyle —someone who understands the pro-circuit , respects the community , is creative and passionate, as well as knows their KPIs.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Develop and lead a 360-degree approach to the consumer journey with digital, PR, social, partnership, point of sales, localization, and more.

• Develop and lead digital strategies that drive business by optimizing our digital marketing mix, driving more traffic to Etail pages across multiple platforms.

• Lead the development of best-in-class POSM and optimize local digital assets to strengthen retail/etail visibility and brand awareness.

• Own overall marketing insights, reporting, and tools, including KPIs setup and measures on ROI, to ensure successful measurement and consistently derive insights from results.

• Collaborate with relevant departments (Regional team / Internal Category & Account Manager team / Agencies) to drive success in the gaming business, identify key players, and coordinate actions.

Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• 7+ years of experience in product marketing or brand management function of the consumer goods industry

• Strong leadership skills and comfortable challenging existing processes and norms - Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence brand strategy across the organization and with distribution partners

• Strong problem solving and decision making ability based on data driven analysis

• Experience in P&L management – managing and successfully growing a product line/category profitability

• Experience with full sales & marketing mix, developing marketing plans and 360 campaigns - In-depth experience in understanding customer preferences, attitudes, and other factors that influence marketing plans and campaigns

• Positive, “Can do, Will do” attitude with unquestionable integrity

• Ability to analyze and understand sales trends at SKU level and use that to develop forecasts and sales plans to drive growth

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix organization, with diverse teams, both functionally and geographically is critical

• -You live and breathe gaming and esports culture, from the pro-circuit storylines to the latest gear drops.

Foundational Month:
New role, new scenery. For your first 30 days, you’ll be based in Munich three days a week (Monday-Wednesday) to learn, bond and get up to speed. We cover the travel and the stay; you bring the talent. It’s the perfect way to fast-track your impact.

#LI-RD1
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure

descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech è il Sweet Spot per le persone che vogliono che le loro azioni abbiano un impatto globale positivo, pur avendo la flessibilità di farlo a modo loro. Posizione: Zurigo Modello di lavoro: 5 giorni / settimana in ufficio (in loco) Il team e il ruolo: Il Gaming Categoria & Marketing Manager — La Svizzera porterà la nostra esecuzione di marketing su più canali sia online che offline e fornire una migliore esperienza di cliente in classe per i nostri utenti finali. Questa posizione lavorerà a stretto contatto con diverse funzioni all'interno del team regionale, Cluster Categoria Manager, eCommerce Marketing Manager, Account Manager e altri ruoli di supporto per guidare la strategia in azione. Non si tratta solo di fogli di calcolo; si tratta dell’ecosistema esports . Stiamo cercando uno specialista di marketing che vive veramente lo stile di vita di gioco —qualcuno che capisce il pro-circuito, rispetta la comunità , è creativo e appassionato, così come conosce i loro KPI. Il tuo contributo: Sii te stesso. Sii aperto. Restate a Hungry e Humble. Collaborate. Sfida. Condividi la nostra passione per l'uguaglianza e l'ambiente. Questi sono i comportamenti e i valori di cui avrete bisogno per il successo a Logitech. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Sviluppare e condurre un approccio a 360 gradi al viaggio dei consumatori con digitale, PR, sociale, partenariato, punto vendita, localizzazione e altro ancora.
• Sviluppare e condurre strategie digitali che spingono il business ottimizzando il nostro mix di marketing digitale, guidando più traffico alle pagine Etail su più piattaforme.
• Condurre lo sviluppo di POSM di classe migliore e ottimizzare i beni digitali locali per rafforzare la visibilità al dettaglio/etail e la consapevolezza del marchio.
• Possedere intuizioni, reportage e strumenti di marketing, tra cui la configurazione e le misure KPI su ROI, per garantire una misurazione di successo e trarre costantemente intuizioni dai risultati.
• Collaborare con i dipartimenti rilevanti (gruppo regionale / team interno Categoria & Account Manager / Agenzie) per guidare il successo nel business di gioco, identificare i giocatori chiave e coordinare le azioni. Qualifiche chiave: Per considerazione, è necessario portare le seguenti competenze e esperienze minime al nostro team:
• 7+ anni di esperienza nel marketing del prodotto o nella funzione di gestione del marchio del settore dei beni di consumo
• Forte capacità di leadership e confortevole sfidare processi e norme esistenti - Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione con la capacità di influenzare la strategia del marchio in tutta l'organizzazione e con i partner di distribuzione
• Forte capacità di problem solving e decision making basata sull'analisi basata sui dati
• Esperienza nella gestione di P&L: gestione e crescita di una linea di prodotti / redditività della categoria
• Esperienza con piena miscela di vendita e marketing, sviluppo di piani di marketing e 360 campagne - Esperienza approfondita nella comprensione delle preferenze dei clienti, atteggiamenti e altri fattori che influenzano i piani di marketing e le campagne
• Positivo, “Can do, Will do” atteggiamento con indiscutibile integrità
• Capacità di analizzare e comprendere le tendenze di vendita a livello SKU e utilizzare che per sviluppare previsioni e piani di vendita per guidare la crescita
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un'organizzazione di matrice, con team diversi, sia funzionale che geograficamente è critica
• -Vivi e respiri la cultura del gioco e dell'esport, dalle storie pro-circuito alle ultime gocce di ingranaggi. Mese Fondazione: Nuovo ruolo, nuovo scenario. Per i tuoi primi 30 giorni, ti troverai a Monaco di Baviera tre giorni alla settimana (lunedì-mercoledì) per imparare, legare e salire alla velocità. Copriamo il viaggio e il soggiorno; porti il talento. È il modo perfetto per velocizzare il vostro impatto. #LI-RD1 Attraverso Logitech siamo in grado di promuovere la collaborazione e il gioco. Aiutiamo i team a collaborare/a partire da qualsiasi luogo, senza compromettere la produttività o la continuità in modo da non sorprendere che la maggior parte dei nostri lavori siano aperti a lavorare da casa dalla maggior parte delle sedi. Il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido permette ad alcuni dipendenti di lavorare da remoto mentre altri lavorano su premi. All'interno di questa struttura

descriptionByLocale.de:
Logitech ist der Sweet Spot für Menschen, die ihre Handlungen eine positive globale Wirkung haben wollen und gleichzeitig die Flexibilität haben, es auf ihre eigene Weise zu tun. Standort : Zürich Arbeitsmodell: 5 Tage/eine Woche im Büro (vor Ort) Das Team und die Rolle: Der Gaming Kategorie & Marketing Manager – die Schweiz führt unsere Marketing-Ausführung über mehrere Kanäle sowohl online als auch offline und liefert ein erstklassiges Kundenerlebnis für unsere Endnutzer. Diese Position wird eng mit verschiedenen Funktionen im Regionalteam, Cluster Category Manager, eCommerce Marketing Manager, Account Manager und anderen unterstützenden Rollen zusammenarbeiten, um die Strategie in Aktion zu bringen. Es geht nicht nur um Tabellenkalkulationen, sondern um das Ökosystem der Esports . Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem Marketing Spezialisten, der wirklich den Gaming-Lifestyle lebt – jemand, der den Pro-Call versteht, die Gemeinschaft respektiert, kreativ und leidenschaftlich ist, sowie ihre KPIs kennt. Ihr Beitrag: Sei selbst. Sei offen. Bleib Hungry und Humble. Zusammenarbeit. Herausforderung. Entscheiden und einfach tun. Teilen Sie unsere Leidenschaft für Gleichheit und Umwelt. Dies sind die Verhaltensweisen und Werte, die Sie bei Logitech erfolgreich benötigen. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Entwickeln und führen Sie einen 360-Grad-Ansatz auf die Customer Journey mit Digital, PR, Social, Partnerschaft, Point of Sales, Lokalisierung und mehr.
• Entwickeln und führen Sie digitale Strategien, die das Geschäft durch Optimierung unserer digitalen Marketing-Mix, treiben mehr Verkehr auf Etail-Seiten auf mehreren Plattformen.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von best-in-class POSM und optimieren Sie lokale digitale Assets, um die Sichtbarkeit und das Markenbewusstsein im Einzelhandel zu stärken.
• Eigene Gesamt-Marketing-Einsichten, Berichterstattung und Tools, einschließlich KPIs-Setup und Maßnahmen auf dem ROI, um eine erfolgreiche Messung zu gewährleisten und konsequent Erkenntnisse aus Ergebnissen abzuleiten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Abteilungen (Regionalteam / Interne Kategorie & Account Manager Team / Agenturen) um den Erfolg im Gaming-Geschäft zu steigern, Schlüsselakteure zu identifizieren und Aktionen zu koordinieren. Schlüsselqualifikationen: Um zu berücksichtigen, müssen Sie folgende Mindestkenntnisse und Erfahrungen in unserem Team mitbringen:
• 7+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmarketing oder Markenmanagement der Konsumgüterindustrie
• Starke Führungsfähigkeiten und eine komfortable Herausforderung bestehender Prozesse und Normen - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, die Markenstrategie über die Organisation und mit Vertriebspartnern zu beeinflussen
• Starke Problemlösung und Entscheidungskompetenz auf Basis datengesteuerter Analyse
• Erfahrung im P&L-Management – Management und erfolgreiches Wachstum einer Produktlinie/Kategorie Rentabilität
• Erfahrung mit vollem Vertriebs- & Marketing-Mix, Entwicklung von Marketingplänen und 360 Kampagnen - Tiefe Erfahrung im Verständnis von Kundenpräferenzen, Einstellungen und anderen Faktoren, die Marketingpläne und Kampagnen beeinflussen
• Positive, “Kann tun, Will tun” Haltung mit unerbittlicher Integrität
• Fähigkeit, Umsatztrends auf SKU-Ebene zu analysieren und zu verstehen und zu nutzen, um Prognosen und Verkaufspläne für Wachstum zu entwickeln
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in einer Matrix-Organisation zu arbeiten, mit verschiedenen Teams, sowohl funktional als auch geographisch kritisch
• - Sie leben und atmen Gaming und esports Kultur, von der Pro-Clock-Geschichte bis zu den neuesten Gangabfällen. Stiftungsmonat: Neue Rolle, neue Landschaft. Für Ihre ersten 30 Tage werden Sie in München drei Tage in der Woche (Montag-Mittwoch) zu lernen, zu verbinden und zu beschleunigen. Wir decken die Reise und den Aufenthalt; Sie bringen das Talent. Es ist der perfekte Weg, um Ihre Auswirkungen schnell zu verfolgen. #LI-RD1 Über Logitech stärken wir die Zusammenarbeit und fördern das Spiel. Wir helfen Teams, von überall zusammenzuarbeiten, ohne auf Produktivität oder Kontinuität zu verzichten, also sollte es keine Überraschung sein, dass die meisten unserer Arbeitsplätze offen sind, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell ermöglicht es einigen Mitarbeitern, remote zu arbeiten, während andere an Prämissen arbeiten. Innerhalb dieser Struktur

Lieu : Zurich Modèle de travail : 5 jours/une semaine au bureau (sur place) L'équipe et le rôle : The Gaming Category & Marketing Manager — Suisse dirigera notre exécution marketing sur plusieurs canaux en ligne et hors ligne et offrira une expérience client de qualité pour nos utilisateurs finaux. Ce poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec différentes fonctions au sein de l'équipe régionale, gestionnaire de la catégorie des grappes, gestionnaire du marketing électronique, gestionnaire de compte, et d'autres rôles d'appui pour mettre la stratégie en pratique. Il ne s'agit pas seulement de tableurs, mais de l'écosystème des sports. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste du marketing qui vit vraiment le style de vie du jeu — quelqu'un qui comprend le pro-circuit, respecte la communauté, est créatif et passionné, ainsi que connaît leurs KPI. Votre contribution : Soyez vous-même. Soyez ouvert. Restez affamés et humbles. Collaborez. Défi. Décider et juste faire. Partager notre passion pour l'égalité et l'environnement. Ce sont les comportements et les valeurs dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir à Logitech. Dans ce rôle, vous:
• Développer et diriger une approche à 360 degrés du parcours des consommateurs avec le numérique, les relations publiques, le social, le partenariat, le point de vente, la localisation, etc.
• Concevoir et diriger des stratégies numériques qui stimulent les entreprises en optimisant notre mix marketing numérique, conduisant plus de trafic vers les pages Etail sur plusieurs plateformes.
• Diriger le développement de POSM de première classe et optimiser les atouts numériques locaux pour renforcer la visibilité et la notoriété de la marque.
• Posséder des idées, des rapports et des outils de marketing, y compris la mise en place d'ICK et des mesures sur le ROI, afin d'assurer une mesure réussie et d'obtenir systématiquement des idées sur les résultats.
• Collaborer avec les départements concernés (équipe régionale/équipe interne de gestion de la catégorie et des comptes/agences) pour stimuler le succès dans le domaine du jeu, identifier les acteurs clés et coordonner les actions. Qualités clés : Pour considération, vous devez apporter les compétences et expériences minimales suivantes à notre équipe:
• 7 ans et plus d'expérience en marketing de produits ou en gestion de marques dans l'industrie des biens de consommation
• Fortes compétences en leadership et confortable défiant les processus et normes existants - Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation avec la capacité d'influencer la stratégie de marque dans l'ensemble de l'organisation et avec les partenaires de distribution
• Forte capacité de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision basée sur l'analyse des données
• Expérience en gestion des P&L – gestion et croissance réussie d'une gamme de produits/catégorie de rentabilité
• Expérience de la combinaison complète des ventes et du marketing, développement de plans marketing et de 360 campagnes - Expérience approfondie de la compréhension des préférences, attitudes et autres facteurs qui influencent les plans marketing et les campagnes
• Positif, peut faire, va faire l'attitude avec une intégrité incontestable
• Capacité d'analyser et de comprendre les tendances des ventes au niveau de l'UGS et d'utiliser celles-ci pour élaborer des prévisions et des plans de ventes pour stimuler la croissance
• La capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration dans une organisation matricielle, avec des équipes diverses, tant sur le plan fonctionnel que géographique, est essentielle;
• -Vous vivez et respirez la culture du jeu et de l'esport, des histoires pro-circuitées aux dernières gouttes de vitesse. Mois de fondation : Nouveau rôle, nouveau décor. Pour vos 30 premiers jours, vous serez basé à Munich trois jours par semaine (lundi-mercredi) pour apprendre, se lier et se lever à la vitesse. Nous couvrons le voyage et le séjour; vous apportez le talent. C'est la façon parfaite d'accélérer votre impact. Je ne sais pas. Partout dans Logitech, nous autonomisons la collaboration et favorisons le jeu. Nous aidons les équipes à collaborer/apprendre de n'importe où, sans compromettre la productivité ou la continuité, il ne devrait donc pas être surprenant que la plupart de nos emplois soient ouverts au travail de la maison depuis la plupart des endroits. Notre modèle de travail hybride permet à certains employés de travailler à distance tandis que d'autres travaillent sur site. Dans cette structure

jobs.title: Sr. User Experience Designer
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role, based in Lausanne - 3 days a week on site

About Us
At Logitech G, our shared belief in gaming is that WE ALL BELIEVE IN THE POWER OF PLAY. We are relentlessly committed to making the world’s most advanced, highest-performing gaming and creator gear for all. Our goal is to create intuitive experiences that empower our gamers to unleash their full potential through our gear and its technology.

The Team
Logitech G is seeking a passionate, highly collaborative Senior UX Designer to join our UX Team in Lausanne, Switzerland. Our new Senior UX Designer must have an outstanding design portfolio and experience in Product Design and User Experience.

The Role:

In this role, you will join our Logitech G Gaming Design Team, reporting to the Head of UX for Logitech G, and you will collaborate within the global multi-disciplinary gaming group. As a Senior User Experience Designer, you'll be at the forefront of creating user-centered design experiences in the consumer electronics industry. Your role involves leading the end-to-end UX design lifecycle and employing quantitative and qualitative metrics to ensure product desirability and acceptability. Collaboration with design, product, and engineering teams will be key to developing platforms central to product experiences.

Your Contribution:

- Develop world-class user experiences for both hardware and software projects.
- Utilize user-centered design processes to drive product innovations.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate user insights into design solutions.
- Advocate for user needs throughout the product design process.
- Present design concepts to multiple teams and senior leadership for feedback.
- Employ tools like Figma, Sketch, and Adobe CS for design and prototyping.

Requirements & Qualifications
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:

• Experience in Design, Human Factors, HCI/HRI, Interaction Design, or related experience in UX design roles focusing on product interactions.

• Strong portfolio showcasing an end-to-end design process that demonstrates not only solid design skills but also forward-thinking solutions.

• Well-versed in user-centered design methods and techniques in a multidisciplinary product development environment.

• Understand the latest development tools, technologies, and processes, and use them effectively based on project needs.

• Proficient skills in concept generation, visualization, and rapid prototyping

• Recognized leadership skills and strong ability to lead by influence.

• The best candidates will be curious, insightful, collaborative, and creative.

Who We Are
We are an action-oriented design and product development company driven to deliver delightful products that help people do and achieve more. We recognize and celebrate a culture of Decide & Do, Open & Ourselves, Humble & Hungry, and Collaborate & Challenge. We work lean and pride ourselves in doing more within the confines of less. Design at Logitech is a key competency and the partnership of design with engineering and product is a significant contributor to our success.

Our Values
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.

Life at Logitech
Logitech is the sweet spot for people passionate about products, making a mark, and having fun doing it. As a company, we’re small and flexible enough for every person to take initiative and make things happen. But we’re big enough in our portfolio, and reach, for those actions to have a global impact. That’s a pretty sweet spot; we always strive to keep it that way.

jobs.title: Head of Product Security
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role - base 3 days on site

At Logitech, our purpose is to extend human potential in work and play.

We do this by designing software-enabled hardware solutions that drive superior performance when gaming and superior productivity while at work, all with maximum comfort, speed and accuracy. We enable creativity when pursuing passions and connectivity so everyone is seen, heard and can contribute in their own unique way.

As a Swiss company focused on innovation and quality, our products are the point of connection between people and the digital world. We harness the transformative power of design to drive innovation and progress throughout our portfolio in order to deliver truly unique and meaningful experiences. With products available in nearly every country and more than 3.5 million items shipped each week, Logitech is dedicated to driving outcomes that are better for people and planet, reducing our environmental impact by leading the industry in designing for sustainability.

The Team and Role:

The Head of Product Security is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and overseeing the comprehensive security strategy for all Logitech products and associated customer-facing services - including Internet of Things (IoT) devices, mobile applications, desktop software, and their related cloud infrastructure and services - throughout their entire lifecycle, ensuring compliance, protecting customer data, and preserving brand trust.

The Head of Product Security leads a dedicated team and a community of product security champions across the globe.

The role is based in Lausanne, and reports to the CISO.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech.
In this role you will have the following responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & Governance

• Architect and execute a comprehensive product security strategy and roadmap aligned with business growth, reporting on risk posture and program performance to executive leadership.

• Integrate Product Security resilience as a competitive differentiator, actively supporting brand trust, enabling new service-based revenue models, and mitigating P&L exposure from legal and product liability risks.

• Develop and implement product security policies, standards, and guidelines.

• Direct global regulatory compliance strategies for mandatory standards such as the EU CRA and UK PSTI, overseeing gap analysis and remediation across cross-functional teams.

• Lead and mentor a high-performing security team while fostering a proactive, collaborative security culture across the global organization.

Secure Product Lifecycle & Engineering

• Champion "Security by Design" by integrating secure development lifecycle practices into all IoT, mobile, desktop, and cloud infrastructure products and development teams.

• Establish and enforce "Safe AI by Design" principles to ensure that AI models, training data, and deployed agents are protected against manipulation, adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and property theft.

• Ensure mandatory disclosure and reporting requirements, such as vulnerability disclosure processes and security update periods, are publicly and accurately communicated.

• Enforce robust supply chain and manufacturing security standards for Operations teams and third-party partners (JDM/ODM) and suppliers to protect firmware, source code, and production integrity.

• Provide expert security advice, guidance and support to engineering and product teams.

• Ensure product decommissioning to maintain security integrity throughout the entire produ

The Role and the Team:
At Logitech, we don’t just build tools. We bridge the gap between people and the digital world. As the world shifts toward a video-first culture, the "Personal Work Solutions" team is at the epicenter of how humans create together, and project their identity and creativity to the world.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who views video not as a utility, but as an experience. You will lead the next generation of video solutions, blending cutting-edge hardware with AI-driven software to create world-class solutions serving millions of users in both B2C and B2B.
This is an exciting role in a fast paced environment, where the right person can make a huge impact. You’ll be based in Lausanne, Switzerland, part of the Personal Work Solutions (PWS) business group. Your role will be global, with occasional travel across regions.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Lead the creation, development, and launch of seamless video experiences and innovative webcam solutions leveraging advanced technologies (AI, computer vision, etc.)

• Enable millions of people worldwide to connect, collaborate, and express themselves with confidence

• Maintain Logitech’s #1 global webcam market position, driving breakthrough product launches for measurable business growth and best in class customer satisfaction

• Guide multidisciplinary teams, working closely with Business, Industrial Design, UX, SW & HW Engineering teams to transform ideas and users insights into iconic, industry-defining products, all the way to mass production

• Ensure end-to-end user journey at every touchpoint. Ensuring our solutions work beautifully for diverse global audiences in B2B & B2C, across 50+ countries

• Deeply understand consumer and enterprise needs to generate actionable insights throughout development

• Shape the future of video interaction through advanced technology integration, competitive intelligence, and proactive identification of innovation and white-space opportunities

• Partner with business teams to explore and execute new revenue opportunities through innovative product offerings

Key Qualifications
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:

• 7+ years of demonstrable experience in a product management position, with successful development and launches of software and hardware solutions

• Experience with video technologies and trends, ideally in video hardware

• Proven track record applying the Design Thinking approaches to drive innovation processes and managing complex initiatives from concept to launch, ideally in a hardware/software integrated environment.

• Curiosity and passion for users. Fluent in conducting user tests and qualitative consumer research

• Strong business acumen with passion for consumer electronics

• Curiosity, hands-on engagement, autonomy, and an entrepreneurial mindset

• Strong analytical skills and technical understanding, with ability to communicate effectively with engineers

• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, capable of motivating teams and working effectively across departments.

• Strong written and oral communication skills in English.

• High energy, a positive attitude, and integrity

Education

• BA/BS in Business, Engineering, or Design.

• MBA is a plus.

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role
Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer
Level: I3
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Working model: Hybrid (2–3 days/week in the office)

We’re looking for a Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer who thrives in complexity, precision and enjoys turning technical systems into simple, elegant user experiences. You’ll be part of Logitech’s Global User Experience team, supporting both the Gaming and Personal Workspace categories — two of the company’s most dynamic and fast-evolving business groups.

This is a unique hybrid role combining:

• Hardware Product User Experience design on platform topics such as connectivity and product behavior. You will create guidelines to harmonize experiences across products.

• Keyboard layout design , requiring high attention to detail, precision, and strong visual craft.

You are a systems thinker with strong product instincts, equally comfortable designing high-level architecture and crafting pixel-perfect layouts. You care deeply about how things work—not just how they look—and you’re motivated by solving real user problems across hardware and software.

Responsibilities
Product & Platform Experience

• Design end-to-end product experiences across hardware interactions with firmware and software in mind

• Contribute to platform-level UX topics (e.g., connectivity, device behaviors, system interactions)

• Translate complex technical constraints into clear, intuitive user experiences

• Define information architecture and interaction models for complex systems

Keyboard Layout Design

• Own and design complex keyboard layouts across multiple products, operating systems, and regions

• Create precise, production-ready layout files with strong attention to detail

• Ensure consistency across languages, markets, and product lines

• Collaborate closely with hardware, engineering, and localization teams to align on constraints

• Maintain and evolve standards, guidelines, and assets for keyboard layouts

Logitech Design System Contribution

• Contribute to the evolution of the Logitech Design System

• Define and document platform (e.g., Bluetooth Connectivity) and product guidelines (e.g., Webcam guidelines)

• Ensure alignment between design and engineering implementation (design ↔ firmware engineering)

• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across products and platforms

• Actively contribute to consistency across Logitech product experiences

• Collaborate with design system and platform teams to improve reusability and quality

Key Qualifications
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
Design & Systems Thinking

• Strong experience designing complex consumer hardware products

• Strong portfolio showcasing hardware design solutions (e.g., consumer electronics, mobile, ergonomic products, etc.)

• Ability to translate product work into reusable guidelines

• Deep understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies

Craft & Execution

• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a high bar for quality and detail

• Excellent understanding of typography, layout and visual hierarchy

• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to deliver production-ready assets

• Understanding of localization challenge, typography, and spatial constraints

Tools & Technical

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator

• Experience with Figma

• 3D application is a plus

Collaboration & Communication

• Experience working closely with engineering and product teams

• Strong storytelling and presentation skills

• Strong in communication with multiple stakeholders and teams

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and fast-paced environments

Life at Logitech

The role and team:
Logitech is the established market leader in video communication solutions for consumers and enterprise users alike. Building on its strong marketing and engineering heritage, Logitech continues to push the boundaries of technology by investing in advanced video processing and AI/ML capabilities.

The Video AI/ML Technology Development Team spearheads the creation of cutting-edge AI/ML algorithms and video pipelines for edge peripherals and host devices. Delivering unique human and machine vision solutions to Logitech’s webcam business, the team is at the forefront of technology and product innovation. Based at the EPFL Innovation Park, Lausanne (Switzerland), this team works closely with Software and Hardware development teams in North America and Asia.

We are looking for a talented Senior Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to join a growing team of Data Engineers, Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning(ML) Engineers and Software Developers, responsible for product and technology development in consumer webcams and applications. Following best practices in AI/ML and SW development, you will work in cross-functional teams across software and hardware engineering, program management, product management and design, to efficiently deliver on a product strategy. You will also work closely with Logitech’s Technology Office in developing the technology portfolio for disruptive innovation.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Develop AI/ML algorithms and video pipelines across the entire model lifecycle: from design to training at scale, optimization, porting and deploying them to (embedded and hosted) target platforms.

• Working with a multidisciplinary team, you will champion best practices to turn cutting-edge research into robust and innovative solutions that define the future of human-machine interaction.

Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• Min. 5–6 years of relevant professional experience in algorithm development (signal processing and AI/ML) with a focus on live video.

• Significant industry experience in deploying deep learning models to real-world consumer products.

• Hands-on experience with latest AI/ML (Deep Learning) techniques and toolchains from architecture to training, evaluation, optimization, and porting to embedded systems (Linux/Android) and clients (MacOS/Windows).

• Experience training and scaling models on distributed computing clusters (e.g., AWS, GCP, or HPC clusters).

• Familiarity with data engineering: collection, generation, augmentation, and governance.

• Experience with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) best practices in embedded systems or host clients.

• Pragmatic, innovative, curious, and autonomous with a strong ability to communicate technical concepts to cross-functional partners.

Skills:

• Design, training, evaluation, and optimization of deep neural networks (CNNs, RNNs, GANs, etc.). Knowledge of Transformers and LLMs is a plus.

• Proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or TinyML, as well as ONNX representations.

• Knowledge of supervised, unsupervised, and self-supervised learning.

• General-purpose programming languages, including Python, C/C++, and C#.

• Software development experience on embedded platforms (e.g., ARM) and embedded AI.

Education:

• MSc in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.

• PhD in a related field is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:
You will be pivotal in developing and optimizing computer vision algorithms used in our video collaboration products. As part of a collaborative group of developers and ML researchers, your work will enhance the user experience in conference rooms worldwide. Your role will involve building and improving software that supports thousands of daily users, emphasizing innovation and quality.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
- Curate annotated images to train Computer Vision/Machine Learning (CV/ML) algorithms/models.
- Augment images to simulate various real-life conditions.
- Write C++ and Python code to build and enhance the training platform for CV models.
- Research existing research papers on CV, enhance existing Open Source models, and incorporate novel techniques or develop new algorithms from scratch to address complex use cases for the Logitech Video Collaboration platform.
- Optimize CV algorithms for embedded platforms running Android or Linux Operating Systems.
- Perform QA/validation on newly trained models and provide feedback to the development team on failure cases.

Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
- Strong background in computer vision and graphics or image processing.
- Knowledge of linear algebra fundamentals and optimization.
- Experience with popular deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, Caffe, or PyTorch.
- Ability to research, prototype, and implement new algorithms in production-level code on an embedded platform (Linux/Android).
- Proficiency in coding with C/C++, Python, Lua, R, Matlab, or a related language.
- Experience in using Source Control/Project Tracking systems like Github or Jira.
- At least one completed complex, real-world CV project as a CV developer with algorithm implementation.
- 3+ years as a Computer Vision/Machine Learning engineer with real-world experience in training framework and tools (TensorFlow, Caffe, PyTorch), model compression, and inference optimization.

#LI-RD1
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role and Team:
We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Chief Commercial Officer, based in Zurich.
This is a highly visible role that combines executive support & business operations. As a trusted partner to the CCO and Leadership Team, you will play a key role in enabling leadership effectiveness, driving operational excellence, and supporting the execution of strategic priorities across a global organization.
Working closely with senior stakeholders across regions and functions, you will manage executive priorities, coordinate key initiatives, facilitate leadership processes, and foster collaboration across teams. In addition, you may provide support to members of the Global Central Team and other senior leaders as business needs require.
The successful candidate will bring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry & Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide & just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Manage complex calendars and schedule meetings, travel arrangements, and other executive commitments, ensuring optimal time allocation and prioritization of meetings, appointments, and events.

• Arrange domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation, while adhering to budget and company travel policies.

• Prepare and manage correspondence, emails, reports, presentations, and other documents as needed.

• Draft and proofread emails, memos, presentations, and other correspondence on behalf of the Chief Commercial Officer and leadership team, ensuring clear and concise communication.

• Coordinate logistics for meetings, prepare agendas and materials, take minutes, and track action items.

• Lead and coordinate global events and executive engagements from planning through execution, partnering with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.

• Assist with special projects, research, data collection, and analysis as required.

• Work as a team with the other existing executive assistants within the organization, communication & team work are key.

• Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and other departments..

• Process expense reports, invoices, and purchase orders, and assist with budget tracking.

• Own new employee onboarding for our team from information sharing and training to adding to communication channels to securing equipment and supporting managers with new employees.

• Become a point person for our team to navigate internal tools and processes.

• Ensure that team members are aware of company policies and procedures, as well as any specific team guidelines.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

• Be flexible and willing to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support executive priorities, leadership activities, business operations, and key organizational events.

• Drive executive rhythm-of-business processes, including quarterly planning, leadership offsites and business reviews.

• Support organizational change management and communication rollouts across teams.

• Facilitate cross-functional alignment between departments and global teams across time zones.

• Support procurement coordination.

• Act as backup support for other Executive Assistants during absences.

• Coordinate internal recognition initiatives, team engagement activities and culture-building efforts.

• Arrange domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation, while adhering to budget and company travel policies.

• Assist with special projects, research, data collection, and analysis as required.
• Work as a team with the other existing executive assistants within the organization, communication & team work are key.
• Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and other departments..
• Process expense reports, invoices, and purchase orders, and assist with budget tracking.
• Own new employee onboarding for our team from information sharing and training to adding to communication channels to securing equipment and supporting managers with new employees.

• Drive executive rhythm-of-business processes, including quarterly planning, leadership offsites and business reviews.

• Facilitate cross-functional alignment between departments and global teams across time zones.
• Support procurement coordination.

jobs.title: Global Product Manager - Simulation
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location : Lausanne, Switzerland
Working Model: Hybrid (2-3 days on-site)

The Team
This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of Simulation at Logitech G. You will be working with team members across the globe, many of whom have been working in this fast-growing category for many years. This is a cross-functional team, with expertise in engineering, software, marketing and launch planning, all with the goal of helping sim racers enjoy their chosen hobby or profession.

The Role
The Product Manager will drive the definition, execution, and delivery of Simulation products used across PC and console. The role includes understanding the simulation category with the ability to identify opportunities and consumer requirements, through a combination of knowledge, intuition, market research, internal feedback and cooperation with our Consumer Insights team.
You will be capable of influencing and contributing to the product strategy and roadmap, enhancing its feature set, and working with cross-functional teams to create the products in said roadmap. Succinctly, the product manager’s role is to choose the right product to develop and then work with the team to make sure that the product is right.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Define and deliver the Logitech simulation product roadmap.

• Develop detailed product requirements for products.

• Collaborate with designers, engineers, and software teams to deliver solutions that meet business and customer needs.

• Work with the Head of Simulation, Marketing and Go-to-market teams to execute a scalable simulation product vision.

• Agreed product strategy with Head of Sim.

• Communication of product benefits and messaging with Marketing.

• Business Case Financials, including forecasting with Go-to-market.

• Creation of user manuals, support FAQs and recommended settings for simulation products, both for new product introductions and as a reaction to issues as part of the product lifecycle monitoring.

• Communicate product status, key issues, and launch plans to stakeholders, including the executive team.

• Continue to monitor products throughout the lifecycle, including issues, consumer feedback etc.

• Manage the day-to-day relationship with first party partners for product submissions and platform changes.

Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• 3-5 years of experience in a similar Product Management or adjacent role.

• Enthusiasm and experience in simulation gaming and/or real world racing/flight is very beneficial, but not a requirement.

• Ability to communicate complicated concepts to both technical and non-technical people.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

• Ambitious, hands-on, with a can-do attitude.

• Intuition for end-user product quality needs.

• Love for solving technical problems in creative ways.
